lines.trans: There's something I've been wondering about for a long time.
Even though we already have the finest seasoning in soy sauce...
Why is any other kind of ramen even necessary?
Personally, I've never been fond of that miso ramen.
Small things sometimes end up going mainstream before you know it.
Hey, what the heck are you doing!
Quite a long game of hide-and-seek you played. Thanks for the cooperation.
You bastards betrayed us!
Is filming people just as they naturally are really indecent?
Listen closely, I'll tell you how it works.
Everything the state designates as indecent becomes indecent—that's what it means.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。
しょう油という最高のダシがあるのに。
examples.trans: Even though we already have the finest seasoning in soy sauce...

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: しょう油という最高のダシがあるのに。
examples.trans: Even though we already have the finest seasoning in soy sauce...

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Expresses frustration, regret, or surprise that reality contradicts what was expected; often trails off at the end of a spoken complaint.

examples.text: 約束したのに来なかった。
examples.trans: Even though they promised, they did not come.

examples.text: せっかくの休みなのに。
examples.trans: Even though it is a hard-earned day off.

meanings.note: Everyday spoken counterpart of なぜ or どうして.

examples.text: なんで知っているんですか。

meanings.note: In casual speech, それ plus は often fuses into そりゃ ('well, as for that / of course').

examples.text: 何でそれ以外のラーメンが必要なんだ？
examples.trans: Why is any other kind of ramen even necessary?

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Used with が before it (ストーリーが必要だ 'a story is needed') or な before a noun.
Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.

examples.text: 俺はあのみそラーメンていうのが苦手でなあ。
examples.trans: Personally, I've never been fond of that miso ramen.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Godan verb; in ～ということ, means 'the fact that...' or 'meaning that...'.

examples.text: それはどういうことですか。
田中さんという人が来ました。

meanings.en: poor at; weak in; not fond of
meanings.note: Na-adjective; target is marked with が.

examples.text: 朝早く起きるのが苦手だ。
examples.trans: I'm bad at waking up early in the morning.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.en: sentence-final particle of emotion or reflection
meanings.note: Colloquial particle expressing sighing, wishing, or emphasis.

examples.text: いいなあ、うらやましい。

meanings.note: Interrogative pronoun for time.

examples.text: いつまでも待っています。

meanings.note: Always pairs with a negative verb; するしかありません means 'have no choice but to do'.

examples.trans: I only have one thousand yen.
There is no choice but to do it.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Expresses change of state, or in polite customer service (になります) states an arrangement or price total.

examples.trans: That comes to one thousand yen.

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

examples.text: 長えかくれんぼしやがって。協力ありがとさん。
examples.trans: Quite a long game of hide-and-seek you played. Thanks for the cooperation.

examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

examples.text: 長えかくれんぼしやがって。協力ありがとさん。
examples.trans: Quite a long game of hide-and-seek you played. Thanks for the cooperation.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Attached to surnames, given names, or company names to show everyday respect; never used for oneself.
Attaches to pronouns or people nouns (僕ら, 彼ら).

examples.text: お前は俺のことを裏切らないって信じてるぞ。
examples.trans: I trust that you will never betray me.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Read ひと when standing as an independent noun.

examples.text: 親切な人に会いました。

meanings.note: Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

meanings.en: to teach; to tell; to show
meanings.note: Ichidan verb.

meanings.en: do for an inferior (tough-guy てやる)
meanings.note: After て-form (勘弁してやる), expresses granting a favor from a position of authority.

examples.trans: I will give you a hand (casual masculine).

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Used adverbially or as a noun to mean 'everything' or 'all of them'.

examples.text: すべてうまくいきました。

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
